show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: John, an underworld don, dies saving timid schoolboy Max—but his spirit lives on inside him. Max transforms into a confident, feared hero, winning admiration and attention. But as John’s violent past resurfaces, Max must fight to stay on the right path.
